headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw a pair of touchdown passes, Marshawn Lynch ran for 145 yards and the Seattle Seahawks routed the hapless Atlanta Falcons 33-10 Sunday in a one-sided rematch of last season's NFC divisional playoffs.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson, Lynch help Seahawks rout Falcons

headlines.description: Calvin Johnson had two second-half touchdown receptions, Reggie Bush rushed for 105 yards and the Detroit Lions beat Jay Cutler and the Chicago Bears 21-19 on Sunday in a key matchup of NFC North rivals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Megatron scores twice as Lions edge Bears

events.name: Philadelphia Eagles at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Nick Foles threw three long touchdown passes and the Philadelphia Eagles pulled away for a 27-13 victory over the injury-ravaged Green Bay Packers, who lost backup quarterback Seneca Wallace to a groin injury on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Foles throws 3 more touchdowns as Eagles roll

headlines.description: Maurice Jones-Drew and Jordan Todman each ran for a touchdown, and the Jacksonville Jaguars got their first win this season by beating the Tennessee Titans 29-27 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaguars hold off Titans for 1st win of season

events.name: St. Louis Rams at Indianapolis Colts

headlines.description: Austin leads Rams to 38-8 blowout at Indianapolis
headlines.shortLinkText: Austin, Rams overthrow Colts in blowout

events.name: Oakland Raiders at New York Giants

headlines.description: Terrell Thomas returned an interception 65 yards to set up a go-ahead 1-yard touchdown run by fellow comebacker Andre Brown, and the New York Giants won their third straight game, 24-20 Sunday over Oakland.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brown leads Giants to 3rd straight win in return

headlines.description: Pittsburgh shut down rookie quarterback EJ Manuel in his return, pounding the Bills in a 23-10 win on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers throttle Manuel, Bills to snap skid

headlines.description: The Baltimore Ravens did everything wrong in their bid to end a three-game losing streak and remain relevant in the playoff chase.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens survive wild rally, top Bengals in OT

headlines.description: Drayton Florence's interception in the final minute sealed a 10-9 victory for Carolina on Sunday to snap the San Francisco 49ers' five-game winning streak and give the Panthers their fifth straight win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers hold down 49ers to win 5th straight

headlines.description: Carson Palmer threw two touchdown passes and the Arizona Cardinals held on to send the Houston Texans to their franchise-record seventh consecutive loss, 27-24 on Sunday.

events.name: Denver Broncos at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Peyton Manning threw for 330 yards and four touchdowns, three to Demaryius Thomas, as he efficiently led the Denver Broncos to a 28-20 victory against San Diego on Sunday in their first game since coach John Fox had heart surgery.
headlines.shortLinkText: Manning, Broncos win 1st game without Fox

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at New Orleans Saints

headlines.description: Drew Brees completed 34 of 41 passes for 392 yards and four touchdowns, and the New Orleans Saints beat the Dallas Cowboys 49-17 on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Saints clobber Cowboys with 40 first downs

events.name: Miami Dolphins at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Mike Glennon threw a 1-yard touchdown pass to tackle Donald Penn and led a long fourth-quarter TD drive to put the Buccaneers ahead for good in a 22-19 victory over the embattled Miami Dolphins on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bucs hold off Dolphins for first win of season
